Subject: Your land dispute matter

Dear Mr. Patel,

Thank you for meeting us on 7 February 2020 about your dispute with Vandana Mittal. As we understand it, construction has started on the disputed plot.

Our advice is to seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot. Please collect photographs of the construction and the land records and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
